name: gh-issue
question: Open one GitHub issue that a recorded decision asks for (the extra arguments: issue create --repo klucilla/refute --title <title> --body-file <committed file>). Permitted GitHub traffic only.
choices: A new unit file (rule (c)); units/gh.json is unchanged. In a job without the container; the operation and the endpoint are journaled. Only the subcommand issue create on klucilla/refute, with a committed body file. A data unit: the arguments make the unit.
